expectationBasis: The commit detail displays `src/search.ts`, a “Changed files” summary, and numeric additions and deletions.

Seed data provides an accessible commit entry in public repository `acme-docs` and changed file `src/search.ts`; opening that entry displays the changed-file path, a “Changed files” summary, and numeric additions and deletions.
The repository page exposes a history link named “Commits”; a commit count may accompany the label without creating another matching link.

uncoveredOutcomes.reason: The clause requires 'numeric additions', but no addition count, statistic format, or literal/accessible-name string for the additions statistic appears in the requirement text, scenario, ancestor contracts, prerequisites, seed declarations, or exactUiStrings; the assertion DSL has no numeric-pattern or value-free statistic check, so every candidate locator or expected text would fabricate UI (a number or markup) that the evidence never declares.

The clause requires 'deletions', but no deletion count, statistic format, or literal/accessible-name string for the deletions statistic is given anywhere in the requirement evidence, so no literal expected text or named control can be asserted without inventing an undeclared value or an undeclared deletion markup role.
